neighbours.label: ' of' after a quantity noun such as couple, pair or set (a couple of, a pair of)
fire: The chart connects two pairs of points with straight lines.
We stayed in Lisbon for a couple of days before flying home.
She ordered a new set of brushes for the workshop.
Grab a handful of nuts from the jar on the shelf.
He spent a couple of hours fixing the bicycle chain.
The kit includes three pairs of gloves and a mask.
A dozen of the old photographs were badly faded.
There was a bunch of letters waiting on the table.
quiet: The chart connects the points with straight lines.
We stayed in Lisbon for two days before flying home.
She ordered new brushes for the workshop.
Grab some nuts from the jar on the shelf.
He spent two hours fixing the bicycle chain.
The kit includes three gloves and a mask.
Twelve old photographs were badly faded.
There were many letters waiting on the table.

notes: ' of' is 11 of the top 32 peaks; reflexive pronouns (herself, itself) and ' protocol' are other strands, not tested here. Probe: 'a couple of apples' peaked on ' couple' (0.27), so the label may sit on the quantity noun rather than ' of'.
